0022600224.text: The Orlando Magic (3-7, 11th in the East) visit the Utah Jazz (1-10, 15th in the West) in the 11th game of Orlando's season, with the Magic 3-3 on the road and Utah on a nine-game losing streak. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain) and Tristan da Silva (calf strain), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Keyonte George (ankle sprain) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and Orlando won the 2025-26 series 2-0, most recently a 120-117 victory in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
